integrity: The mathematical proof is analytic. Finite rational and phase checks were executed on the included standalone verification script. No claim of independent audit or external certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Positive bonds on an increasing-degree star with one uniform field and an interaction-strength lower bound only; inverse uniqueness holds for the limiting empirical distribution, not finite labeled couplings or noise-robust recovery. General Blaschke/paraorthogonal literature remains a possible broader-coverage risk.
title: Coupling-law tomography from Lee–Yang zeros of inhomogeneous Ising stars
